title: Tool: delegate work to a visible minion (herdr agents pane) via runecode minion launch — never headless
description:
Why: the travel use case is: hand bounded work to the bot, it drives minions on the Studio, returns once. Estate rule: minions run in herdr agents panes, never headless; the brief is a file. Do: implement as an MCP stdio server OUTSIDE the fork if possible (onlytools/minion: minion-mcp exposing minion_launch(task_id, brief_path, sweech_profile, engine), minion_status(name), minion_stop(name)) so any product can use it; if the minion repo cannot take it this week, a builtin tool in the fork is acceptable but must shell out to runecode minion launch --transport herdr --sweech-profile

with HERDR_SOCKET pointing at the agents session and assert containment (herdr --session agents pane get succeeds AND default-session pane get returns pane_not_found). Add an ActionApprovalRule require_approval for it by default. AC: from a chat, the bot launches a minion on a named keel task into the agents session; the pane is visible in herdr --session agents pane list; the bot reports the pane id and stops; the approval prompt is shown before launch.
